facts.fact: The Right to Access Information Commission presented its 6th annual report, submitted under Section 41 of the RAIC Act, to the Minister of Information and Civic Education on 17 November 2025, showing the body in operation.
facts.system: Right to Access Information Act (RAIC Act)

note: Report gives proactive disclosure by 79 public bodies (up from 10) but no count of requests or complaints, so no applied fact; the Act's year is not given, so no in-force fact.
